identity_rules: Only identical stable source keys are combined; no matching by spelling, dates, artwork, martyr group name, or place.

Historical sanctoral art subjects may be events, groups or angels, not people.
The only 30 complete-format biography records remain subject to their existing editorial-publication gates.
No Mass, Calendar, Sacred Art or map ownership is transferred by this derived ledger.
